content:
Alex Chen: Heads up — PR #9321 is blocking rc-1. We need two approvals before the 10:00 PT cutoff. The change is the kv-cache fallback + a tiny env var parsing tweak. @Maria Rojas @Zoe Patel can one of you give a quick eyes?
Maria Rojas: On it, I'll do a pass in ~30m. If it's small I can approve.
Zoe Patel: I can take it after standup (~20m). If you want fast turnaround tag me and I'll prioritize.
Tyler Nguyen: left one tiny comment about `PARSE_ENV` edge case — not blocking unless you care about the behavior when a var is empty.
Alex Chen: thanks. that comment sounds like a 2-line fix — i'll branch a follow-up if needed. We do need a second person to formally approve though. Pinging @Devon Park for a second-eye.
Devon Park: I'm stepping out but will look in ~10m. If it's trivial i'll approve.
deploy-bot: Merge gate: requires 2 approvals for rc-1. Window open until 10:00 PT. Failure to reach 2x approvals will postpone roll and trigger rollback plan.
Maria Rojas: quick pass done — LGTM after Tyler's env-var nit is addressed. left an inline suggestion. :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: Tyler, can you either push the tiny fix or confirm you want me to follow-up? We should avoid holding the window for a non-blocker.
Tyler Nguyen: pushing a 1-line commit now: `fix: handle empty PARSE_ENV as empty string` — tests pass locally.
Devon Park: LGTM. Re-ran the diff; small test added looks good. Approving now.
Alex Chen: Perfect — that's 2 approvals. I'll merge at 09:45 PT to get ahead of the cutoff. Thanks all for the quick turnaround.
Maria Rojas: nice. I'll watch the smoke once deploy starts.
Zoe Patel: thanks, team. If anything flakey pop up ping me in #eng-oncall.
Alex Chen: noted — will post deploy link here once it's live.
